g.text: A TDFam-built custom operator family that treats Gaussian splats as
native TD scene data: load .ply/.spz, edit and optimise (Frustum
Delete, Thin Splat, Blowout), convert splats to a physics particle
system, blend/morph splats, and render with a shader effects stack
(bokeh, true-3D motion blur, relighting from standard Light COMPs,
chroma key, colour correction, refractive render). Quick start:
drop GSOP Splat Scene → set file path → “Init Splat Render
